By the panting chargers raising dust at dawn, mankind is ungrateful to his Lord, witnesses it himself and is intense in love of wealth.
When the graves' contents are scattered and what is in the breasts is laid bare, their Lord will be fully acquainted with them that Day.
On the Day of the Striking Calamity people are like scattered moths and mountains like fluffed wool; heavy scales bring a pleasant life, light scales an intensely hot Fire.
Competing for more distracts people until they visit the graves; they will surely see Hellfire with certainty and be asked that Day about their pleasures.
By time, mankind is in loss, except those who believe, do righteous deeds and urge one another to truth and patience.
Woe to every scorner and mocker who hoards and counts his wealth, thinking it will make him immortal.
He will be thrown into the Crusher, Allah's ever-fueled fire that rises over the hearts and closes upon them in extended columns.
Allah foiled the plan of the companions of the elephant, sending flocks of birds that struck them with stones of hard clay, leaving them like eaten straw.
For the Quraysh's accustomed security in their winter and summer caravans, let them worship the Lord of this House, who fed them against hunger and secured them from fear.
The one who denies the Recompense is he who drives away the orphan and does not urge feeding the poor.
Woe to those who pray but are heedless of their prayer, who make a show of their deeds and withhold simple help.
Allah granted the Prophet al-Kawthar, so he should pray to his Lord and sacrifice, and his enemy is the one cut off.
The Prophet tells the disbelievers he will not worship what they worship nor they what he worships; they have their religion and he has his.
When Allah's victory and the conquest come and people enter Allah's religion in crowds, exalt your Lord with praise and seek His forgiveness, for He accepts repentance.
May Abu Lahab's hands be ruined; his wealth will not avail him, and he and his wife, Umm Jamil, the carrier of firewood with a fiber rope, will burn.
Allah is One, the Eternal Refuge; He neither begets nor is born, and nothing is equal to Him.
Seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of His creation, of settling darkness, of those who blow on knots, and of the envier when he envies.
Seek refuge in the Lord, Sovereign and God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers into people's breasts, from among jinn and mankind.
